evals.prompt: /gcpr implement the cursor-pagination endpoint and keep pushing verified checkpoints.
evals.expected_output: Reads the installed git-commit skill completely and runs it in mode push realtime with the rest of the request as the task.
assertions: The installed git-commit skill is read completely, including references/checkpoints.md, before any Git command runs.
Each checkpoint is pushed and its upstream parity proven before the next one begins.

evals.prompt: $gcpr on this refactor. The git-commit skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any Git command and reports that git-commit must also be installed.
assertions: No Git repository is inspected or changed once git-commit is found to be missing.
The report names git-commit as the missing dependency.
The workflow is not rebuilt from memory and no other alias is used instead.

evals.expected_output: Recognizes a natural-language request rather than the alias selector and uses git-commit directly in the mode the words select.
assertions: The selector-only gcpr alias is not chosen from phrasing alone.
git-commit states the resolved mode before its first Git command.

evals.prompt: /gcpr but skip the upstream parity check after each push, it slows things down.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to drop the parity proof, because the alias may not weaken the git-commit workflow it delegates to.
assertions: The upstream parity proof still runs after each push.
The next checkpoint does not begin before the previous push is confirmed.

evals.prompt: $gcpr finish on feature/export. Its upstream is origin/main.
evals.expected_output: Commits on feature/export and verifies the same commit on remote feature/export before proceeding.
assertions: The source name is captured before work starts.
An explicit refspec publishes the reviewed SHA on refs/heads/feature/export.
origin/main stays unchanged. A local commit or a matching stale tracking ref is insufficient.
